content: I'm wondering how long should one expect project compilation time to take, I'm vibe-coding a formalization of the Levi-Civita connection, so I'm importing a lot of structure from MathLib. But when I make a single line change to a file which no other files depend on, it takes like 10 mins to compile! I don't know if this is normal or not, when I look at the output of lake build for that individual file, most of the time seems to be spent on MathLib imports. Is this normal?
did you download the cache?
If you are not touching mathlib then it should never compile it
I used the start new project with MathLib4 in VScode, so the repo has all of the MathLib4 code inside it
in .lake/packages/mathlib
I don't know if I've downloaded the cache honestly, I'm a total beginner
Riccardo Brasca has marked this topic as unresolved.
Having mathlib in the .lake folder is normal. Just to confirm: you want to prove a new theorem and use mathlib, right? Not modifying mathlib itself
correct yes
would making the GitHub repo public and sharing the link help?
OK, then close all files you have In VS Code, then under the ∀ icon select Porject Actions --> Download mathlib cache

okay I've run:

[Fetch Mathlib Build Cache] Fetching Mathlib build artifact cache [(Click for details)](command:lean4.troubleshooting.showOutput)
I think it is supposed to do this automatically when you create a new project, so maybe something went wrong. If it still compiles it's easier to fix it in the command line
Does it work?
yup the cache is downloaded
To check open any file in your project that imports mathlib. If the file does not import anything from your project it should not recompile anything

okay that seemed to compile much faster, though it's currently hanging on one of my files probably because I've not closed the file properly, I have

noncomputable section

namespace DiffGeom

end LeviCivita

end DiffGeom

end

end LeanVerification

The code snipped you posted does not import anything

(Are you aware of #36845, by the way?)
haha I was not! Thanks, though I'd still like to get this compilation stuff sorted out

Michael Kiss said:

I made some changes to the file and it seems to rebuild all of the mathlib dependencies again

This should not happen. Close all files and open a terminal (inside VS Code if you want) and do the following:

  • lake exe mk_all (so we are sure all files are added to Projectname.lean
  • lake exe cache get!
  • lake build
it should compile only files in your project
okay, the second command is taking a while to finish running, currently have 8115 files downloaded and now it's stuck
let it finish
okay it's finished, but when I ran lake build I still saw some MathLib imports building
and despite lake build finishing, when I boot up the server in VScode it takes quite a while to compile

Michael Kiss said:

okay it's finished, but when I ran lake build I still saw some MathLib imports building

If it was super fast that's ok, it didn't really compile anything.
if you did lake build nothing else should be compiled.
okay yeah it was fairly quick, like 30 seconds maybe
